values.title: Post-seal optical-operation comparison
values.statement: NIST experimental records support photon interference, polarization observables and nonlinear sum, difference, second-, third- and four-wave mixing classes. The exact half-One support normalization remains a sealed Fold relation rather than an imported susceptibility or measured universal amplitude.
values.generation_rule: Generate the complete eight-axis post-seal optical-operation comparison product.
values.grammar_boundary: Every registered NIST interference, polarization and nonlinear-mixing row together with the normalization and material-response controls.
values.exact_result: Interference, transverse polarization observables and nonlinear frequency mixing are externally supported; the Fold half-One is not asserted to equal every physical amplitude or susceptibility coefficient.
values.induction_base: The NIST photon-interference observation is retained.
values.induction_step: Polarization and each nonlinear frequency-operation row append without fitting a coefficient or deleting material conditions.
exclusions: no claim that every material realizes every operation at the same strength
target_rows: complete registered NIST/CODATA/PDG/APS vector including unfavorable controls
values.falsification_condition: Controlled optical experiments cease to exhibit interference or conservation-governed nonlinear mixing, or the validation silently equates a structural Fold share with an unmeasured universal amplitude.
